buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to

increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF): The bidder must submit an OEM authorization letter issued by t he OEM. 2. OEM Experience: The OEM should have a minimum of three years' experience in manufacturing and sup plying computer systems in India. 3. Past Performance: The bidder should have successfully executed similar supply orders for Government Departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies. 4. Warranty: The offered product must carry a minimum of two years comprehensive onsite OEM warranty. 5. Service Support: The OEM/bidder must provide onsite support and have an authorized service mechanis m to ensure timely maintenance and repairs. 6. Installation and Commissioning: Supply, installation, configuration, testing, and commissioning of the sy stems on site shall be included in the scope of work without any additional cost.Undertaking of the same o n Firms letter head should be provided with the bid. 7. Replacement Commitment: In case of major hardware failure, the defective equipment shall be repaired or replaced within the specified time period. 8. Technical Compliance: The bidder must submit detailed technical datasheets and a compliance stateme nt against all specifications. 9. Genuine Products: Only brand-new, unused, and genuine products sourced through authorized channels shall be accepted. 10 Serial Number Verification: The serial numbers and warranty status of all supplied systems must be verifiable through the OEM's official records or support portal. Document must be attached with the bid do cuments. 11. Penalty for Non-Performance: Delay in delivery or failure to provide warranty support may attract pena lties as per GeM terms and conditions. 12. End-of-Life Declaration: The offered model should not be end-of-life or end-of-support and should rema in supported by the OEM during the warranty period. 13. The OEM should have an office /Service Center in Ladakh /J&K region to ensure immediate tech suppor t An official confirmation on the OEM's letterhead or relevant documentation must be provided. 14 An Affidavit be submitted by the bidder on Rs 100 Stamp Paper duly signed by Notary that the firm is n

ot blacklisted from any Govt agency or PSU.( The affidavit should not be more than 03 months old.) 15. Only mentioned make/model will be Accepted with seller OEM Authorization certificate required with th e bid. 16 OEM/bidder should have experience of supply of similar goods in Ladakh or J&K , Copy of supply orders and completion certificate/CRAC should be provided .
